An agent loop you can inspect

The Loop · React, FastAPI, SQLite, Groq

The Loop turns a brief into a website through four stages: plan, generate, evaluate, and improve. Each pass leaves a draft and an evaluation record, so you can see what changed and keep the best version.

  1. Evaluation. Deterministic checks and a model rubric score each draft. Evaluation criteria are frozen per run so later edits do not change the comparison.
  2. Durability. The queue saves state and checkpoints. Queued jobs recover after a restart, while interrupted runs retain their drafts without automatically replaying paid inference.
  3. Isolation. Generated HTML opens in a sandbox. Projects have per-user ownership checks, and evaluation profiles support rollback.

The worker is single-instance. Cancellation happens between stages, and static checks complement browser testing.

Training from scratch

StorySeed · Tokenization, causal attention, evaluation

I built a small English story model from random initialization. The work moved from a character baseline through byte-pair encoding, causal attention, a decoder, and repeatable evaluation.

The recovery model was trained for 48,000 updates. On the same 200 reserved stories, bits per UTF-8 byte went from 1.708 to 0.626. The comparison measures the combined changes.

Story coherence remains experimental. The public repository documents the evaluation and keeps trained weights local.
